description: Implementation of the Road Infrastructure Improvement Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Road Development Authority has called for bids following the national competitive bidding procedure to select contractors for the implementation of several road infrastructure improvement projects. The proposals made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award the relevant contracts as follows, based on recommendations submitted by High Level Procurement Committees after evaluating the bids received for the same, were approved by the Cabinet: Serial No.Road SectionNo. of bids receivedRecommended bidderValue (excluding VAT)01Blackpool-Ambewela -Pattipola-Horton Plains Road (from 12+500km-18+000km) (B512)03M/s Asset Engineering (Pvt) Ltd.Rs.744.68 million02Gomburuoya-Balapokuna Road - from Ch.0+000km to  Ch.8+500km (excluding Ch.5+250km to Ch.5+450km and Ch.6+900km to Ch.7+150km)01M/s Nagma Engineering (Pvt) Ltd.Rs.645.69 million03Lady Maccalum Drive Road (from 0+000km to 2+700km) (B249)03M/s K.D.A. Weerasinghe & Co (Pvt) Ltd.Rs.711.93 million04Palapathwala - Galewela Road (from 19+000km to 27+000km) (B346)05M/s Senerath Engineering (Pvt) Ltd.Rs.1,291.80 million05Kadawatha - Ragama - Welisara Road (from 3+000km to 8+050km) (B168)02M/s Komuthi Engineering Services (Pvt) Ltd.Rs.666.62 million
